headline: Anthropic Plans US IPO and Up to $3.5 Billion Japan Share Offering
summary: AI startup Anthropic plans to raise up to $3.5 billion in Japan as part of a US initial public offering. Regulatory documents indicate the operational terms will be finalized between November 2026 and April 2027.
why: Anthropic is a major developer of advanced artificial intelligence models and chatbots, competing directly with OpenAI and Google. An IPO of this scale represents a significant liquidity event in the AI sector.
